incoming_learnings: Distinguish exhausted ordinary frontiers from a verified completed floor. Investigate resource-funded missing-exit search admission when hunger reduces a cumulative search ceiling. Validate the actual safe route and work budget before changing admission; further searching is not proof of finding the exit. Preserve mandatory progression pickups, hazard exclusions and honest potion-effect receipts.

review.review: The Mage defeated Goo, then starved after entrance-shop scouting stalled. At decision 2240 (selection line 6539), the shop controller chose a door branch while observed, reachable entrance frontiers remained. Subsequent branch exploration consumed the visit budget; decision 2373 (lines 6846–6848) begins fallback waiting after the shop-search veto. Decision 2812 (lines 8131–8132) records the final wait from 1 HP to zero, with an explicit starvation message. This is advancing-time failure, not an execution deadlock. The initiating ordering defect is in tools/shop_tactics.py: entrance doors are considered before unfinished entrance frontiers. The proposed correction reverses that ordering only for existing admitted paths wholly inside the observed entrance-side component. It does not claim the shop was found, credit unfinished loot, raise budgets, or identify unknown potions. A condensed public-geometry regression fails on the original policy and passes on the candidate; all 1596 Python tests pass, with four skipped. Full historical policy memory at decision 2240 was not recovered; a separate public-map fixture admits the alternative without claiming recorded runtime memory or a successful counterfactual run.
review.learnings: Finish reachable scouting within the entrance-side chamber before exploring its door branches. Keep shop visitation dependent on actual nearby stock or a shopkeeper, preserve mandatory progression pickups, and do not mistake an admitted scouting move for finding the shop or surviving the floor.
